analysis:
Reviewed the supplied batch analysis against the canonical definition index and full T-041 excerpt. No source units are replayed: integration_source explicitly omits both reviewed units. Consequently, the reported CHANGELOG.md edits at head lines 11–39 and historical text at 2633–3156 cannot be independently verified here, and no concrete regression supports a finding.
The reported change introduces account waitlists for sandbox installation and coordinator-connected cluster setup, preserving existing setups and local/offline pairs. Remaining material review questions are whether the CLI binds approval to the authenticated account before setup side effects, how it recognizes existing setups, and whether compatibility fallback distinguishes an explicitly unsupported waitlist service from authentication or network failures. Review the changed CLI/coordinator contract against TB-013/T-061 and TB-002/TB-011; waitlist eligibility must remain distinct from serving authorization (A-016, T-052/T-053). Neither enforcement nor its absence is established by the supplied evidence.
T-041's account-scoped encrypted SSD cache contract was examined. The analysis reports historical resident-cache documentation outside the changed ranges; that report is not evidence of a cache regression in this PR. No supplied implementation establishes changes to encryption, prompt exposure, billing, attestation, privileged helpers or cache isolation. Further review requires the actual changed documentation and setup/fallback implementations, not unrelated unchanged dependencies.
